title: Bouncetry
tagline: A ball only breaks its own colour and one tap flips every brick

fr.tagline: Un mur de verre rouge et bleu au-dessus de la lave. Tape pour inverser toutes les couleurs en plein vol.

en.tagline: A wall of red and blue glass over a lake of lava. Tap to flip every colour while the ball is mid-air.

description: A wall of red and blue glass over a lake of lava. A ball only breaks its own colour and never changes it on its own, so the tap that swaps the whole wall — as often as you like while the ball is in the air — is the only colour control you have. The dotted sight solves five bounces ahead.

fr.tagline: Une balle ne casse que sa couleur et un tap retourne toutes les briques
